name: pickup_spawn_from_parsed_zrd_entry
description: Pickup::SpawnFromParsedZrdEntry unpacks a parsed ZRD pickup entry into SpawnAt and copies the parsed respawn delay onto the created spawn definition.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred to the Pickup spawn/source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41dc30 validates ECX as the parsed entry, typeDesc at entry+0x04, amount at entry+0x08, position at entry+0x0c, rotation at entry+0x18, param at entry+0x28, respawnDelay at entry+0x30, the call to Pickup::SpawnAt, the null result guard, and the respawn-delay copy to PickupSpawnDef+0x30.

The native smoke routes a parsed entry through the real SpawnAt path and verifies pickup type, amount, position, rotation, spawn parameter, copied respawn delay, generated name/id, scene linkage, spawn-list linkage, and object transform propagation.
